items.title: Two Sum: do number jinka jod target ho, ek pass mein
items.one_idea: Two Sum: for each number ask whether its partner (target minus the number) was already seen; a hash map answers that in one step, so one pass over the list replaces checking every pair.
items.spoken_hook: List में दो number, जिनका जोड़ 11{ग्यारह} हो, कैसे ढूँढें?
items.hook_source: direct_question: the problem itself as a plain question, no term used before it is explained (owner 2026-10-22); hookscore 44 WEAK, no DEALBREAKER
items.visual_idea: Row of five cells (5 1 12 3 8), target chip 11; brute-force arcs with counter to 10; then a walking pointer and a seen table filling; at 8 the arrow 11-8=3 jumps to the table row for 3.
items.example: EXAMPLE list [5,1,12,3,8] target 11; answer [3,4]. Brute force 10 checks, one pass 5 steps. EXAMPLE 10,000 numbers: 49,995,000 pair checks vs 10,000 steps.
items.pattern: complement lookup with a hash map
items.check_question: List [2,7,11,15], target 26: which indices? (answer [2,3], in the caption)
